## 🦉 I'm Manas!

*AI/ML Enthusiast &nbsp;•&nbsp; Cloud & DevOps Explorer &nbsp;•&nbsp; Full-Stack Developer &nbsp;•&nbsp; Content Creator*

I am a student of Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, a competitive programmer, a full-stack developer, a content creator, an AI/ML enthusiast, and a Cloud & DevOps explorer. I love learning new things, building apps and smart tools that solve real problems, and sharing what I learn along the way.

- 🧠 Building and training models (TensorFlow, OpenCV, scikit-image) and turning them into full pipelines.
- ☁️ Designing **Cloud-native** systems with Firebase, PostgreSQL, and REST/RAG architectures for real deployments
- 🏆 Competitive programmer: Pupil @ Codeforces · 1★ @ CodeChef · Highest CGPA Award (First Year)
- 🎥 I write and teach what I learn : two Instagram pages and a YouTube channel breaking down **business, AI/ML, and cloud computing**
- 🤝 **Actively open to research opportunities and internships** in **AI/ML, Cloud Computing, and DevOps** : always up for a conversation about interesting problems in this space
